This looks really lovely — clean, easy to read, and the favorites/read-later/archive views and search all feel natural. A couple of things stop it short of what I need before I'd call it done, though:

1. **Saving is more work than I expected.** When I paste in a web address, I want it to go fetch the page's title and description (and its little icon) for me automatically, so I usually don't have to type anything. Right now I have to fill in the title and the note myself — if I leave the title blank it just uses the web address. Grabbing that info for me is a big part of why I wanted this.

2. **I can't actually delete a bookmark.** The menu only lets me edit or move something to the archive. Archiving is great for tucking things away, but I also need a way to get rid of a bookmark for good when I'm sure I don't want it. Those should be two different things.

One smaller thing while you're in there: when I see a tag on a bookmark, I'd expect to be able to click it and see everything else with that same tag.

The rest — search, the different views, sorting, the layouts — feels good enough for how I'll use it. If you can sort out the automatic page info and a real delete, I think this will be there.
